name: 32668 · Morriston, FL
findings: ZIP 32668 (Morriston) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32668 (Morriston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32668 (Morriston) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
